description: The line plot titled “Finetuning for different r, WikiHow” illustrates the ROUGE-1 scores achieved by four different fine-tuning methods as a function of the logarithm of the rank parameter r (log r), evaluated on the WikiHow dataset. The x-axis, labeled “log r”, spans from 0 to 9 with a linear scale and tick marks at integer intervals (0, 1, 2, ..., 9). The y-axis, labeled “ROUGE-1”, ranges from 0 to 35 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, ..., 35). Four methods are compared: “MBart + LoRA” (red circles with solid line), “T5 + AdaLoRA” (green circles with solid line), “T5 + AdaLoRA” (green circles with solid line — note: this appears to be a duplicate label in the legend; likely one should be “T5 + LoRA” or similar, but as plotted, both green and orange are labeled “T5 + AdaLoRA” and “MBart + AdaLoRA” respectively), and “MBart + AdaLoRA” (orange circles with solid line). The green line (“T5 + AdaLoRA”) starts at approximately ROUGE-1 = 23 at log r = 0, rises steeply to ~36 at log r = 4, and plateaus near 36 for log r from 4 to 9. The orange line (“MBart + AdaLoRA”) begins at ~12 at log r = 0, increases to ~21 at log r = 2, then climbs to ~30 at log r = 4, and continues rising slightly to ~33.5 by log r = 9. The red line (“MBart + LoRA”) starts at ~23, rises to ~28 at log r = 3, peaks at ~29 at log r = 4, then gradually declines to ~27 at log r = 9. The purple line (“MBart + LoRA” — likely mislabeled; should be “T5 + LoRA” or similar) begins at ~12, drops sharply to ~5 at log r = 1, then rises steeply to ~25 at log r = 3, and plateaus near 27 from log r = 4 to 9. All lines are connected with solid lines and marked with circular data points at each log r value.
